title: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

sense.text:
“A nation of fierce countenance”: a people full of hatred, with no emotion in them. This damn devil does not even care about his own people. They shot a woman in the face in her car, a woman who was no criminal, only trying to move away from the ICE agents, and there was no remorse, no empathy, and the president of the United States did not even bat an eye. So what do you think is going to happen to our people? You think he gives a damn about our people? No. It does not matter if you speak perfect English, or did a tour in Vietnam or the Persian Gulf and killed people who look just like you. All you get is a little pension, a little house, a car, but you will never rise above the condition of your people.

“Which shall not regard the person of the old”: they do not care if you are eighty or ninety years old, walking with a cane or in a wheelchair. “Nor shew favour to the young”: they detain our children and separate them from their families. That is what the Most High is showing us in the ICE agents holding a five-year-old girl hostage to find so-called Latinos, and in the young man arrested and beaten, bruised and scarred, for not having alien paperwork.

And still our people think they can make a league, an allegiance, with the damn devil and everything will be all right. You cannot save yourself from this devil. You so-called Latinos have to wake up to your true nationality.

precepts.why:
“The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together.” The ancestors in this country used to hang together, and not hanging out in the streets: they hanged us on the trees together. You so-called Latinos cannot get away from your black brothers. The northern kingdom cannot get away from the southern kingdom. We will be oppressed together until Christ returns. So whose side are you on? Are you for God and for your people, or just for your own selfish self?

There was a thought that it would only be the ones who look black, the black-looking northern kingdom, who would be deported. But no, he does not give a damn. It is a nation of fierce countenance. You cannot deny your race and you cannot put another nation above your people: that is traitorous and treacherous, and there is a judgment for it from the Most High.

“And all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.” That is this nation of fierce countenance. They refused to let us go from captivity, from oppression, from slavery. We have been in slavery and oppressed since the 1400s, and the condition does not go around us because we are a lighter shade or because we speak Spanish. Spanish is not our native tongue. It is the language of the oppressors.

sense.text:
The orange man’s skin tells you what he is about: he is Esau, the red man, and orange is still the same thing. We are not supposed to vote for other nations to be over us.

“To the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.” He puts whoever he wants in. It does not matter who you vote for, because your vote does not count: it is the electoral vote.

“And setteth up over it the basest of men.” We have Donald Trump, one of the basest of men. People say he stinks so bad, he smells like death, that they do not even want to be around him. He was a TV personality, famous for The Apprentice, a caricature; it has always been like that, as Ronald Reagan was an actor. The Most High puts these men over us so that we can see what it is to want other nations to rule over us besides him.

precepts.why:
“And shalt say, I will set a king over me”: that is what our people say. We are not satisfied with the King of kings and Lord of lords, Christ, being over us. “Like as all the nations that are about me”: we always want to be like the other nations. That is why we dye our hair blonde, put the contacts in, put on the suit and tie, go to their universities and get their education, and assimilate to their way of life.

“Whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren.” The Most High chooses who is king over us, and he has to be of our people and for our people, not a base man out for the interest of corporations who want to rob and steal our resources. “Thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.” Thus saith the Lord.

The same goes for our people in Latin America. In Mexico they set up Claudia Sheinbaum; in Argentina, Javier Milei, an Italian. What are they doing for you? Not a damn thing. You cannot set up people of other nations over you. That is why the Most High sets up the basest of men over us.

“No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life.” That is what we are doing when we bring out these scriptures and do these classes, go to camp, and travel looking for the twelve tribes of Israel: warring in the spirit, because there is a spiritual war for the minds and souls of our people, and we have to be on the right side of history.

So we do not entangle ourselves with the affairs of this life: voting, politics, sports. At work the main topics are politics, sports, what you did over the weekend, the barbecue. Nonsense. We look at the news to decipher it, to match what is going on in the world with what the scriptures say, so we know what time we are in and how close our salvation is: watching as well as praying.

“That he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” We are trying to please Christ, not Donald Trump, and not to appease America. We are disruptors of this kingdom. Many of us will be put to death or go to jail for this word, and it is all a part of what we have to go through to get salvation. We will not save ourselves by betraying our people. Nobody trusts a traitor.

sense.text:
A so-called Latino in a red MAGA hat says he would deport his own parents back to El Salvador, to the prisons where they shave heads and make men walk with their heads down: a sellout of the people who gave him life. The hat does not make you better than your people, and you will never rise above the condition of your people.

“But unto us confusion of faces.” You think because you speak English, have a degree or served in the military, you will rise above and get away from the curses. No. It is all confusion of faces. Esau has done a number on us: we take Ozempic to look skinny like them, bleach our skin and hair, cut our noses to spite our face. Look at Michael Jackson, Lil’ Kim, Sammy Sosa, a black man first and foremost who hated himself so much he bleached his skin, and Serena Williams, a beautiful black sister with full, thick lips who did more collagen and now looks like a damn scary movie, with that damn dead animal on her head. That is the Frankenstein mentality: Esau is the scientist and we are the experiments. That is the sickness of our people. We are confused; we do not know who we are.

“To the men of Judah”: Judah first and foremost. “And to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off”: all twelve tribes, all throughout the world, trying to look like Esau and act like Esau. “Through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass”: because of our sins. So the Most High allows the basest of men to rule over us, and we try to look like them in all ways.

“Who hated their own people”: you have to hate your own people to betray them, like the fat boy in the red MAGA hat who would deport his own parents for not having paperwork from Esau. That paperwork means nothing. The scripture says the earth is ours; we don’t need no damn paperwork. Our paperwork is the Bible.

It is also Esau’s witchcraft. He tells you to join the military, see the world, get college tuition, and your family will be good. What he does not tell you is that you have to go to the countries of your people and oppress them and kill them. His military is poor white trash and mainly poor blacks and Latinos who kill their own people, black and brown people who look just like them: in Panama, Venezuela, the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua, Libya, Iraq.

“went unto the king, and told him”: they are going to rat us out. Our own people who hate us will betray us.

precepts.why: Not everybody who looks like you is of us. “Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect”: the word of God has not failed and is not going to fail. “For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel.” Just because someone looks like you, speaks the same language as you and eats the same food as you does not mean he is of your people. We have to be aware of this.

“Because iniquity shall abound”: because sin shall abound, “the love of many shall wax cold.” Emotionless, no empathy, no feeling for your people or even your parents. That is what we are seeing.

If they do that now, imagine when we are making noise. They already pass laws and put a media blackout on us, but it is going to reach such a level that they will want to put us to death thinking they are doing good. Salvation in Esau’s kingdom is only for a moment, and there is a judgment for betraying your people. Look at Judas, the main betrayer: he betrayed Christ for thirty pieces of silver, and he killed himself because he knew it was evil. The red MAGA hat gives you no superpowers and does not hide your brown skin or your black skin. It only makes you look more like a clown and a traitor.

sense.text:
Latino comes from Ladino, as the Bishop has brought out countless times. In 1496 and 1497 the Portuguese kings rounded up hundreds of thousands of Jews and sent them into exile on the West African coast, the islands of Cape Verde and St. Thomas, into a life of perpetual slavery: the Iberian Moorish Hebrews, meaning black Hebrews of Portugal and Spain. They were called Ladinos, Latinized Negroes, a racist term used for the black Jews of Iberia, who were deported to African islands and used as the first slaves on the sugar plantations. It is the same thing over again with the Cuban deported to Africa: you cannot escape the curses. So-called Latinos, even if you are light, you are a Latinized Negro. You are the Israelites. Your name is Israel.

“And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword”: being called outside of your God-given name. Israel means prince of the power with God, and there is no mightier name on the face of the earth. Why would you call yourself a Latinized Negro, a Latino? It is a racist term. Do the history and the knowledge; find yourself so you do not lose yourself.

“Among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.” This is not a black movement or a Negro movement. The twelve tribes of Israel are mainly so-called Latinos.

precepts.why:
“And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen.” We leave our name, Israel, for a curse: for a racist term like Latino or Hispanic, or Cuban, Colombian, Venezuelan, Dominican. Dominican: I hate that name. It sounds horrible, dummy in a can. We are God’s chosen people, and we have to see the greatness in who we are. We have fallen so far that we think we cannot come out of it, but there is a God.

“For the Lord God shall slay thee”: for wanting a king of another nation over us and wanting to assimilate, the Most High slew us and caused the basest of men to rule over us. “And call his servants by another name”: now we are called Latino, called blacks, spics, wetbacks, illegal aliens. That is why we do not know who we are: confusion of faces. We are searching, but not searching the scriptures. We have to get back to our history and our true nationality.

sense.text:
“And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.” The blessing is what we need. With Venezuela on the news, the scriptures show through the spirit of the Most High who they are: the tribe of Asher, from Colombia to Uruguay. It is easy to decipher who we are when we look at things spiritually.

“Let Asher be blessed with children”: that is his blessing and his birthright. “Let him be acceptable to his brethren”, because he is going to be so different from us. When the conquistadors came to conquer, destroy, rob and pillage, as it is to this day, many fled into the jungles of the Amazon and grew up without fathers, uncivilized, with bones in their noses, eating spiders and walking naked. Those are the uncontacted people of the Amazon rainforest, running from the face of the red man, the orange man. So we have to go there too and save our people in the jungles of Peru, Venezuela, Colombia and Brazil.

“And let him dip his foot in oil.” Asked how Venezuelans and Colombians can benefit from their oil, a brother answers standing in the oil itself: we are rich, and even without it we are rich in the water and the air. He knows his blessing. Oil, petróleo: the precious commodity the red man covets so earnestly. Venezuelans, Colombians, Peruvians, Brazilians: that is Asher.

“Thy shoes shall be iron”: for those who do not believe the northern kingdom is the northern kingdom, it is no coincidence what these countries are named. Brazil is linked with the Hebrew word barzel, meaning iron. Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela and Ecuador are full of iron; Mexico has iron too, but not in the same abundance as South America. These people know where our people are.

“And brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.” That is the inheritance of our people in these lands. The elders in the 60s and 70s deciphered this with nothing but the scriptures and history books, without Google or the internet. Now in the information age it is so much plainer.

The mayor of Chicago is offended by the term alien and calls it racist language. But the term alien is in the scriptures, and we will see who the alien is. “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach”: see what has come over us, the curses that fell upon us for our sins.

“Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” That is what alien means: stranger. When the scriptures speak of aliens they are speaking of the strangers, the other nations. We are not the aliens. We are the natives of these lands. Esau has taken our lands, our resources and our inheritance.

“We are orphans and fatherless”: that is what we saw with Asher in the Amazon. They killed our fathers and our leaders, our caciques, Atahualpa, Caonabo, all our kings, burning them at the stake for not accepting the Christian religion. It is all documented in history, but we have to see it with the scriptures. “Our mothers are as widows”: our women are left widows.

“We have drunken our water for money”: we have to buy the water; they package it and sell it to us. “Our wood is sold unto us”: they go into our countries and take the timber for their houses, and sell it back to us at an exorbitant price.

“Our necks are under persecution”: ICE agents run up in our houses and our places of business, the shops and mechanic shops of the hardworking northern kingdom, handymen and construction workers. We built this country. “We labour, and have no rest”: we have to watch our backs for ICE agents who arrest us, kidnap our children and deport us to Africa. We have no rest in this country; it was not meant for us to rest. These things have to happen.

“We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians”: the Egyptians and the Assyrians represent the oppressor, and our main oppressor today is Esau. “To be satisfied with bread”: if I work hard, send my children to their school, learn English, work hard for the white man, I can assimilate and I have made it. No.

“Our fathers have sinned, and are not”: they are dead and gone. “And we have borne their iniquities”: their sins are our sins, because the Most High visits the sins of the fathers to the third and fourth generation. So basically we are our fathers.

“Servants have ruled over us”: the Most High made Esau to serve us, but we are serving them now. They took down the statue of Theodore Roosevelt on the horse, but it is too late: we know who they are, and they know who we are.

“There is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” No man can deliver us. Hugo Chávez could not, Fidel Castro could not, Maduro could not, even with Russian helicopters and Chinese spyware. Maduro’s thirty-two Cuban bodyguards went back to Cuba in little boxes draped with the Cuban flag. This man is the devil the Bible speaks of. The groups of our people picking up arms, the so-called Black Panthers, are agitation and agents provocateurs setting us up for failure: you have no factories, and you would have to go to your enemy for the bullets. Blacks and Latinos do not have the nuclear capability and are not going to get it.

Our job, brothers and sisters, is to keep God’s commandments and the faith of Christ. That is our power. When we do that, the Most High and his angels will fight for us. We have to see ourselves in these scriptures no longer as blacks or Latinos, but as one people, one nation, and we are coming together.

precepts.why:
Why are we orphans? “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.” We see it all throughout history, and now in the children of the northern kingdom separated from their parents. You so-called Latinos are no different from your black brothers, the Haitians, the Jamaicans, the African Americans: we are the same people, oppressed together. Now it is your turn, and these curses have to afflict you so that you can see who you are in these scriptures.

“And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long”: you look to Cesare Borgia, the white Jesus, and that damn devil cannot save you. Donald Trump and the US government are not going to save you; however much you perfect your English, the accent will slip out and they will catch you.

“And there shall be no might in thine hand” to save our children: grown men with weapons and body armor surrounding a five-year-old autistic girl and holding her hostage, a nation of fierce countenance. All this happens so you can see this is your book, and what is happening to you for turning your back on the black Messiah, Jesus Christ. That is the basis of this class: we have to return to our true nationality.

Why do we have to get deported? “I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence”: till we acknowledge our sins, “and seek my face.” We seek God’s face through the scriptures, and when we read Revelation 1:14 we see he looks just like us: a black God for a black people.

“In their affliction they will seek me early.” Many think this is the American dream and what life is about: a house, a car, barbecue on the weekend, sports, the kids in college. That is Esau’s way of life, and it is death and oppression. The Most High has to afflict us to remind us this is not our rest.

“Arise ye, and depart”: separate yourself from these heathen nations, the strangers, the aliens. “For this is not your rest.” You were not brought here on slave ships to be comfortable, to assimilate and to be friends with these heathen nations. You see the betrayal time and again when you make a league with the strangers, the real alien.

“Because it is polluted”: wicked, evil, deceptive. Witchcraft is in this place, so strong that it has you bleaching your skin, dyeing your hair blonde, putting in contacts, starving yourself to look like a flat-butt, flat-chested crackhead woman. “It shall destroy you”: it destroyed Sammy Sosa, Serena Williams, Lil’ Kim. Esau upholds those celebrities so our people look up to them and want to be like them; it is witchcraft to make a black man hate himself so much that he destroys his own face.

“Even with a sore destruction”: destruction is coming to this place. This kingdom will not last forever; we are in the last days. Judah has shown the way, and now it is the turn of you so-called Latinos. When you see heads of state like Nicolás Maduro kidnapped and his country’s resources stolen, it is for you to wake up. Our people need us.

How do we know our main oppressor is Esau? “Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom”: Edom is the so-called white man’s biblical name. “The cup also shall pass through unto thee”: the cup of affliction and oppression is going to pass to them. “Thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked”: his evil is being revealed, and this is only the beginning.

“The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion”: our punishment is coming to an end. It is time to wake up and rise up like the army of God that we are. “He will no more carry thee away into captivity”: this one here in America is our last and final captivity.

“He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” God is going to judge Esau for the evil done to his people. Everything this devil does is going to be revealed, with his judgment for it.

“As for us”: as for Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help”: our lying help. Esau is not here to help us; he has deceived us. “In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” They want no part of us and cannot save us, no matter how hard we try.

Look at him on the screen: Donald Trump looks at him like he is a dumbass, and the other one will not even look at him, because he is a clown. They despise you and use you to deceive and betray your people. Because one gets through, they think everyone can. Giving one Diddy or one Jay-Z millions is chump change compared to the destruction caused when they lead our people astray into thinking this is our way of life and that we can assimilate.

“Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them”: we cannot serve idols, Christianity, the white Jesus. “For I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.” That is why we have borne the iniquities of our fathers.

Watch the image of Roosevelt on the horse come to life and see it in the spirit: “I have seen servants upon horses.” The horse represents authority, power, rulership. “And princes walking as servants upon the earth”: the northern kingdom on the one side and the southern kingdom on the other, walking on foot beside him. Esau knows who he is, and he knows this is his time to rule. But it is coming to an end.

“These things hast thou done, and I kept silence”: destroyed my people, put them in chains and yokes of iron, had them hating themselves and their people. “Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself”: because he did not bring swift judgment while he was punishing us for our iniquities, Esau thought God was with him and looked like him. No, Esau: God is a black God, and Jesus Christ is a black God.

“But I will reprove thee”: the Most High will reprove Esau for the evil he has done to our people. “And set them in order before thine eyes”: he is setting Israel in order before Esau’s eyes. They may call us whatever they want, say we are playing costume, Power Rangers, LA Lakers; we may seem harmless, a bunch of spics in purple and gold, but we are God’s army, his chosen people rising up.

While they are busy stealing land and resources, the Most High is setting us in order and giving us time to get our minds, our spirits, our families and our children right, and to come out of drugs, drug dealing, gangs, alcoholism, prostitution, and selling our people out.

sense.text:
A predator is an organism that exists by preying upon other organisms, and a person or group that plunders, pillages or robs as in war. That is Esau: a group, a nation, with Donald Trump as its figurehead. He went to Venezuela under the pretense of justice and democracy, but all he wanted was the precious resources, and he took them by war. Now they claim this hemisphere as theirs, as the Monroe Doctrine has said since the 1800s: Greenland, Canada, the Gulf of America, Panama. Esau has to be revealed, and we reveal the devil with the scriptures, so you can see this red man is not your friend. We want no part of him or his policies.

“And the first came out red”: warning. When you see the red man coming, destruction and death are coming. Flee. “All over like an hairy garment”: his attributes are that he is red and hairy; even their women have to shave practically their whole body to normalize their appearance. “And they called his name Esau.”

“And after that came his brother out”: Jacob is not described, because he looked like his parents. Esau was so different from his brother: two nations, two manner of people were in the womb. We are not the same, and no matter how hard we try we cannot be like them. They are a degenerate, evil, wicked seed.

“Esau was a cunning hunter”: hunter, predator, killer, all the same thing. “A man of the field.” That is his attribute: he loves to kill and loves to prey. “And Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents”: our attribute is plain. We like to think simple, farm, live off the land, and do our sacrifices to God.

“Bless me, even me also, O my father.” The blessing Esau begged of his father was “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above.” But how would he get those places?

“And by thy sword shalt thou live”: by armies, by killing, destroying and preying upon other nations. That is his attribute and what we see on the news; it is not hard to decipher when you see things through the spirit of the Most High.

“And shalt serve thy brother”: he is meant to serve us, Israel, the sons of Jacob. “And it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” He broke the yoke and is over us now, because we wanted to be like the other nations and wanted a king over us, a base man; the Most High is a jealous God and cursed us to have a base man over us. So now we are looking at his dominion.

precepts.why:
“And behold a pale horse”: the pale horse represents Esau. “And his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him”: everywhere he goes is death and hell, in Libya, Iraq, Iran, Venezuela, Cuba, Panama. “And power was given unto them”: dominion was given to Esau, the blessing of Genesis 27:40.

“Over the fourth part of the earth.” The Bishop always brings out the book The Fourth Part of the World: imperial ambition and the birth of America. The fourth part of the world is South America, Central America and North America, the western hemisphere. He knows who he is; that is why he says this is our hemisphere.

“To kill with sword”: by the sword shalt thou live, with armies, weapons and nuclear capabilities. “And with hunger”: famine. Donald Trump says Cuba looks ready to fall, because he cut off the oil and the trade and is starving them out. “And with death”: there is no remorse in their faces; as Stokely Carmichael said, you are dealing with a people who have no conscience. “And with the beasts of the earth”: zoonosis, mixing animal DNA in their science, as with Fauci and the COVID vaccine, to poison us, kill us and conquer us.

“For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation.” Habakkuk was a prophet in Babylon, and this is twofold: it speaks of America, the daughter of the Chaldeans, the daughter of Babylon, and Esau is that daughter.

“Which shall march through the breadth of the land”: the western hemisphere, and everything Uncle Sam has conquered, Haiti, Venezuela, Iraq twice, Sudan, Nigeria, Afghanistan, Syria, conquering with death, with famine and with the beasts of the earth. “To possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs”: they have some 850 military bases in nearly every country. The Arabs and the Chinese have no military bases here in America, but Esau has his in their lands. If Esau is not the devil, then who is?

sense.text:
“And through his policy”: through economics, economic warfare. He is starving out the Cubans, and you cannot fight if you are hungry. Esau is patient: since the so-called Cuban Revolution of the 60s he has been biding his time, cutting off their oil and their economy and putting sanctions on them until they bow down.

“Also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: witchcraft. We think the American dollar is almighty, but there is no gold behind it; that piece of paper is craft. Behind the scenes he makes war to protect it: Gaddafi was about to unify African countries with African gold stronger than the dollar, and Venezuela was dealing with China and Russia outside the dollar. That is why Esau went to war with them. The same craft has Floyd Mayweather flaunting a bag full of money before black people and speaking up for the Israelis instead of for his own people.

“And he shall magnify himself in his heart”: he is the basest of men, but in his mind he is the greatest thing on earth, with no God and no one beside him. “And by peace shall destroy many”: Donald Trump and Netanyahu, the biggest warmongers on earth, hold a peace summit; they caused the war, and when they say peace everybody goes back to sleep.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: he will be so elevated in his mind that he thinks he can go up against Christ. “But he shall be broken without hand.” His military might is nothing compared to Christ and his angels; Christ will break him with the power of his words.

precepts.why:
“And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame.” Christ shall destroy them “without labour by the law.” That is why we keep God’s laws and teach God’s laws: by them this evil, wicked kingdom is going to be destroyed. God’s law is like fire to them.

So do not think the foolishness of preaching is doing nothing to this wicked kingdom. It is like a cancer in their bodies, and you can see it in the red man, the orange man in office: bloated, needing IVs, covering up his hands, his ankles swollen. He is being destroyed from within.

sense.text:
“Let no man deceive you by any means”: do not be deceived, brothers and sisters. “For that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first”: the day of Christ does not come until there is a falling away. We had to go into captivity, and Jerusalem had to be taken over by the Gentiles, as it is to this day.

“And that man of sin be revealed.” He is being revealed so much through social media, TikTok and Instagram, that Esau, America and Israel now have a propaganda campaign, 700 million given to Christian groups to cover up the evil they are doing. But no amount of money can cover up the genocide in Gaza that our people have seen with their own eyes: mass killing and starvation. So we have to come behind that and show the people through the scriptures who this man really is. “The son of perdition”: the son of hell.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: he is sitting in Jerusalem as God’s people. That is why Christ let us know in Revelation 2:9 and 3:9 that he is the synagogue of Satan. “Shewing himself that he is God”: with his images of Cesare Borgia as Christ.

“Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?” Paul told us these things had to happen. “And now ye know what withholdeth”: what is holding Christ back, “that he might be revealed in his time.” The devil must be revealed, and he is revealed through the words of the prophets and through us teaching God’s laws, laws that are like fire to these people.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth”: only Christ, who allows it, “will let, until he be taken out of the way.” Only Christ can take this damn demonic nation out of the way. “And then shall that Wicked be revealed”, with a capital W. That is why they throw money at Christian groups and celebrities, to hide their sins so they are not revealed.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming.” His coming is so bright and so powerful that it will destroy Esau; they will tremble when Christ returns with his angels.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power”: all the power Satan gave him, “and signs and lying wonders”, “and with all deceivableness of unrighteousness”: all trickery and sin. “In them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth”: our people who do not receive the love of the truth will perish, the traitors in MAGA hats who would sell out their own people for a house on a quarter acre. Whatever you get from Esau is not enough. “That they might be saved”: the Most High is giving us a chance to repent. Now is the time; it is high time to awake out of sleep.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion”: because you did not receive the love of the truth, God sends you strong delusion, so you think you can be saved by Esau and hide under his skirt from the curses. Look at the grandmother crying for Cesare Borgia, a false god, an idol that cannot save us: that is the craft that prospers in his hand, and the mind state of many of our people. “That they should believe a lie”: it is all a lie, and we have been lied to.

But the curses have an end, and we are waking up. It is a fixed fight: all we have to do is keep the commandments and the faith of Christ, and the Most High will fight for us. Do not fear, so you do not fall into that strong delusion. Pray for more laborers, that this word goes out to the four corners of the earth. We have a big job, brothers and sisters.

precepts.why: “And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”: him being Esau. “Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world”: our people who do not repent and keep God’s commandments do not have their names written in the book of life. They are the ones who worship this damn bastard demon as Christ.
